attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2322010)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/God_of_War_Ragnarök
Fandom (godofwar.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://godofwar.fandom.com/wiki/God_of_War_Ragnarök
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough is linked but not written, and only Controls, Table of Contents and Trophies subpages exist. godofwar.fandom.com answers the API, with about 218 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's first search hit was a separate PC entry (god-of-war-ragnarok-2, no release date); the detail was replaced with the main entry god-of-war-ragnarok (id 494384). The Steam schema calls the app "Steel Magnolia" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2322010. 29 of 48 Steam achievements are hidden. The 5 hidden ones listed after "Invitation Accepted" were put in Valhalla by schema position. The rest sit in the main story chapter, but several with low unlock rates (about 20 to 31 percent, such as "The True Queen" and "Trials by Fire") are probably optional content and need checking.
